backupManifest.note: Verbatim pre-cleanup snapshot of the CLCPA ingest store. Restore a record by PATCHing cr2bf_dacingesttesttabledata1s(<id>) with its cr2bf_rows, or re-create a deleted record by POSTing its fields. No history entries were touched by the cleanup, so changehistory.json is a reference copy only.

rule: Emely 2026-09-02: whole records byte-equal to the payload are DELETED; records where any NON-derived cell differs are KEPT with their derived cells nulled. A1/2025 is pre-ruled: keep the two typed zeros, null 9.48.
